status.summary: Digital Realty's release of 24 August 2026 states that Singapore is today home to its three operational data centers with about 84 MW of combined capacity; its Singapore metro page lists exactly three facilities, SIN10 at 29A International Business Park and SIN11/SIN12 at Loyang, and its 2020 release identifies SIN12 as the third. SIN10 is therefore operating as of 24 August 2026, a publication-normalised date, not an inspection or opening date. Its share of the 84 MW is not stated and is not asserted.

additions.successor_review: Checked on 27 October 2026: Digital Realty's English sitemap lists no Singapore release after 24 August; the SIN10 page (sitemap lastmod 19 August) and metro page (14 October) still list SIN10 as a Digital Realty data centre; third-quarter 2026 results are scheduled for 29 October 2026, after this check. No closure, sale or redevelopment was found. Status stays operational as of 24 August 2026.

context_updates.identity_review: Same campus as the existing record 'China Mobile Plateau Big Data Center Phase 2 Build' (site 'China Mobile Plateau Big Data Center Haidong'; 中国移动(青海海东)数据中心, Haidong Industrial Park / Hehuang New Area, Qinghai). The park committee's 27 August 2026 record names '移动数据中心110kV变电站', the 110 kV substation of the China Mobile data centre, beside '电信数据中心二期', using the park's short forms for the China Mobile and China Telecom data-centre campuses. The record's locator source (the Phase 2 Stage 1 EIA) places the existing Phase 1 Plateau Big Data Center north of the Phase 2 site, and the 2 September 2026 governor's visit (evidence a5250c40) records Phase 2 as the campus's current build; the Atlas has no other China Mobile record in Haidong or Qinghai. The record does not say which phase the substation serves or where on the campus it stands, so it is attached as campus power-supply context for the current Phase 2 build without asserting that it serves Phase 2 alone. The record's status (under construction as of 2 September 2026), project locator and capacity facts are unchanged. No other Atlas site lies within 2 km; the held Zhipu-iFlytek Haidong base (EIA point about 540 m east) and the held China Telecom Phase 2 (named in the same record, no locator) are not Atlas records.
context_updates.summary: The Haidong Industrial Park / Hehuang New Area Management Committee recorded that on 27 August 2026 the 110 kV substation of the China Mobile data centre (移动数据中心110kV变电站) was one of the construction sites under way in the park, where park officials checked flood safety and asked about progress. Power-readiness context only: the record gives no substation capacity, location, completion or energisation date and does not name the phase it serves, and the record's 2 September 2026 Phase 2 construction observation, locator and capacity facts are unchanged.

context_updates.identity_review: Same project as the existing record 'China Unicom Ningxia Zhongwei Cloud Data Center — Park No. 2 Data Centre 9 (DC9)'. Its campus locator is the EIA station centre of this same substation ('2025年中国联通宁夏中卫云数据中心3号变电站新建工程', evidence 66a7c62c), which the report places inside the China Unicom Zhongwei Cloud Data Center reserved land and which the 24 August 2026 Park No. 2 board (evidence a9127788) lists as part of Park No. 2. The approval letter and the planning permit name the same project and the same builder, China United Network Communications Co., Ltd. Ningxia Branch, as the DC9 permit (6405022026GG0065673, evidence b2c226d6). The substation permit (6405022026GG0067629) was issued on 14 September 2026, the date of the DC9 permit that supports the record's permitted status, for the same two real-estate units (640502102227GB00384W, 640502102227GB00371W) and the same boundaries (Unicom cloud-data land to the east, Fengyun Road to the south, Tejiasen land to the west, the CGN Yuntian photovoltaic site to the north). The EIA states that the substation secures power for the cloud data centre's growing load but does not allocate its capacity to DC9, so it is attached as Park No. 2 power-supply context. Within 2 km the only other Atlas site is China Mobile (Ningxia Zhongwei) Data Center B-Zone, 766 m away (different operator); the record's status, locator and capacity facts are unchanged.
context_updates.summary: The Zhongwei Ecology and Environment Bureau approved on 19 August 2026 (卫环函〔2026〕89号) the EIA report form for the 2025 China Unicom Ningxia Zhongwei Cloud Data Center No.3 substation, a new 110 kV substation with 3 x 80 MVA of transformers, two 110 kV incoming circuits, 48 10 kV outgoing circuits and 3.1 km of new 110 kV line, and the Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau issued its construction-project planning permit on 14 September 2026 (6405022026GG0067629, 3,353.1 m2, published 21 September) for the same parcels as DC9. Power-readiness context only: these are consents for grid works, not evidence that the substation has been built or energised; transformer MVA is not the data centre's IT or grid-connection capacity, and DC9's permitted status of 14 September 2026, its locator and its capacity facts are unchanged.
